user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want a board for the current Quarter and a matrix of the whole VA Cycle (a strip showing all four Quarters, then one row per System with its milestone dots against their due weeks), as two tabs, so that I see both today's work and the year.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want a board for the current Quarter and a matrix of the whole VA Cycle (a strip showing all four Quarters, then one row per System with its milestone dots against their due weeks), as two tabs, so that I see both today's work and the year.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Spring Boot + JPA + Flyway schema group, cycle/quarter/milestone due-week derivation, shadcn/ui tabs with board and matrix views

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want to endorse a VA Submission that is Awaiting Endorsement, so that the System's VA for this Cycle is complete.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want to endorse a VA Submission that is Awaiting Endorsement, so that the System's VA for this Cycle is complete.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Spring Boot state-transition service + single endpoint, shadcn/ui confirmation dialog

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want to return a submission to the SMO/Tech Lead with comments, so that I can challenge something the Cyber Manager confirmed.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want to return a submission to the SMO/Tech Lead with comments, so that I can challenge something the Cyber Manager confirmed.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Single comment table, Spring Boot service + endpoint, React Hook Form + Zod comment dialog

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want to endorse after week 13, with the submission marked Endorsed Late, so that late work still completes and the lateness stays visible.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want to endorse after week 13, with the submission marked Endorsed Late, so that late work still completes and the lateness stays visible.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Week-13 deadline rule layered on endorsement service, shadcn/ui badge

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want any VA Submission that isn't Endorsed or Exempted when the VA Cycle closes (4 weeks after Q4 ends, or earlier if I close it) to become Not Endorsed, so that each Cycle's report is final.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want any VA Submission that isn't Endorsed or Exempted when the VA Cycle closes (4 weeks after Q4 ends, or earlier if I close it) to become Not Endorsed, so that each Cycle's report is final.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Spring Boot bulk status transition, Spring Scheduling + ShedLock auto-close job, manual close endpoint + dialog

user_stories.title: As one of the two VA POCs, I want items the other VA POC has handled to clear from my list with "handled by (name)", so that we don't duplicate work.
user_stories.verifiable: As one of the two VA POCs, I want items the other VA POC has handled to clear from my list with "handled by (name)", so that we don't duplicate work.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Spring Boot worklist query using recorded actor history, shadcn/ui indicator

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want to be blocked from endorsing a VA Submission I acted on at another step, for example as its SMO, so that the other VA POC endorses it.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want to be blocked from endorsing a VA Submission I acted on at another step, for example as its SMO, so that the other VA POC endorses it.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Segregation-of-duties guard using step-actor history, shadcn/ui alert

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want to see Systems in the Quarter that have no VA Submission yet as Not Started, and Overdue after week 2, so that I can chase SMOs who haven't begun.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want to see Systems in the Quarter that have no VA Submission yet as Not Started, and Overdue after week 2, so that I can chase SMOs who haven't begun.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Derived status (no stored rows) with week-2 overdue rule, shadcn/ui board section

user_stories.title: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want to request an Exemption at any time before endorsement, with evidence of a VA done within the 3 months before the Quarter or one scheduled within the 3 months after, so that my System isn't assessed twice.
user_stories.verifiable: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want to request an Exemption at any time before endorsement, with evidence of a VA done within the 3 months before the Quarter or one scheduled within the 3 months after, so that my System isn't assessed twice.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Single-table Flyway/JPA schema, Spring Boot service with date-window validation, Spring MVC routes with springdoc, React Hook Form + Zod request form on shadcn/ui

user_stories.title: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want my submission frozen while the Exemption request is pending, and returned to exactly its previous state if the request is rejected, so that I don't lose work.
user_stories.verifiable: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want my submission frozen while the Exemption request is pending, and returned to exactly its previous state if the request is rejected, so that I don't lose work.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Spring Boot state-snapshot/restore logic using the exemption record's previous-state snapshot (submission data model assumed provided by other submission stories); shadcn/ui banner with TanStack Query status

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want a list of Exemption requests waiting on my dashboard, so that I can decide them promptly.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want a list of Exemption requests waiting on my dashboard, so that I can decide them promptly.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Single read endpoint restricted to VA POC role; TanStack Table list (Medium frontend module)

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want to approve or reject an Exemption, with approval making the submission Exempted while keeping its work for audit, so that the outcome is clear and traceable.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want to approve or reject an Exemption, with approval making the submission Exempted while keeping its work for audit, so that the outcome is clear and traceable.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Spring Boot decision/state-transition service reusing freeze/restore, two endpoints, React Hook Form + shadcn/ui dialog; audit via be_audit_service

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want an Exemption based on a future VA to stay conditional, and, if that VA doesn't happen within 3 months, the System to be flagged and returned to its previous state (or Not Started) with new 2-week windows from the date it's flagged and endorsement due by the later of its Quarter's end and the Cycle's close, so that Exemptions can't be used to dodge the VA.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want an Exemption based on a future VA to stay conditional, and, if that VA doesn't happen within 3 months, the System to be flagged and returned to its previous state (or Not Started) with new 2-week windows from the date it's flagged and endorsement due by the later of its Quarter's end and the Cycle's close, so that Exemptions can't be used to dodge the VA.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Complex business logic (deadline/window recomputation, flag + restore), Spring @Scheduled + ShedLock daily job, shadcn/ui status widget; Quarter/Cycle calendar data assumed from other batches

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want a management summary export (counts by Quarter and state, Endorsed Late, and a by-System table with SMO, state, Overdue and the number of open Deviations) in Excel or PDF, with no vulnerability details, so that it's safe to circulate.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want a management summary export (counts by Quarter and state, Endorsed Late, and a by-System table with SMO, state, Overdue and the number of open Deviations) in Excel or PDF, with no vulnerability details, so that it's safe to circulate.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: JasperReports (Report_Core multi_format: Excel + PDF), aggregate queries over submission data from other batches, single export endpoint, shadcn/ui export widget

user_stories.title: As a VA POC or Auditor, I want an append-only audit log of every view, download, upload, status change, confirmation, Dispute, return, endorsement, Exemption decision, Register change, role change and export, so that every action is accountable.

user_stories.title: As a Cyber Manager, I want to see the audit history of the VA Submissions I reviewed, so that I can trace what happened to them.
user_stories.verifiable: As a Cyber Manager, I want to see the audit history of the VA Submissions I reviewed, so that I can trace what happened to them.

user_stories.duration_assumptions: Apache PDFBox + Apache POI watermark/classification stamping for PDF and Excel outputs, classification rule based on export scope

user_stories.title: As a VA POC, I want to approve a list of records due for disposal after their retention period, with a fresh MFA sign-in, so that data is deleted on time, with approval, and never by a hijacked session.
user_stories.verifiable: As a VA POC, I want to approve a list of records due for disposal after their retention period, with a fresh MFA sign-in, so that data is deleted on time, with approval, and never by a hijacked session.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Standalone MFA path assumed (User_Standalone -> MFA_Core TOTP-only -> MFA_Critical_Transaction -> MFA_Frontend/Standalone); Spring @Scheduled + ShedLock retention job, AOP-gated approval/deletion service, TanStack Table approval page

user_stories.title: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want reminders 5 days before and on the end of week 2, then weekly while Overdue with the Cyber Manager copied in, so that I don't miss my window.
user_stories.verifiable: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want reminders 5 days before and on the end of week 2, then weekly while Overdue with the Cyber Manager copied in, so that I don't miss my window.

user_stories.title: As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want every Scan Report file to go through one upload pipeline (quarantine, malware scan, type allowlist, schema check, storage) before anything reads it, so that a bad file is rejected before it can do harm and one or more files can be uploaded for each of the three Scan Report types.
user_stories.verifiable:
As an SMO/Tech Lead, I want to upload one or more files for each of the three Scan Report types, so that a System with several components or hosts still has one Scan Report of each type.
Every upload is quarantined, malware-scanned, type-checked against the allowlist for its Scan Report type and schema-checked, in that order, before it is read; a malware verdict, a disallowed type, an unreadable or schema-invalid file, or a scan dated in the future is rejected.
A malware scan that times out is retried twice, then the upload is rejected with a plain message telling the SMO/Tech Lead to upload again.
A file cannot be viewed or downloaded until it has passed the malware scan, and only by someone allowed to see that System.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: File MCC standard (full tier: S3 quarantine/clean store + SFS virus scan), Spring Retry for scan timeouts, multi-step pipeline orchestration (Large), react-dropzone multi-file upload

Dependency-Check XML and JSON exports are read; each vulnerability (CVE or GHSA) plus package becomes one Finding with its severity, with one occurrence per component or file; the scan date and target are pre-filled from the file.
Parsing is tested through the upload endpoint with sample exports made from a throwaway test target, plus malformed, disallowed-type, too-old and future-dated files.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Finding + occurrence two-table schema, Jackson XML/JSON streaming parser plugged into the upload pipeline, React Hook Form + Zod pre-filled form

ARF and XCCDF results XML are read; failed checks (fail) and checks that did not complete (error, unknown) become Findings identified by rule id, one occurrence per host; passed, not-applicable and not-checked results are ignored; the scan end time and target are pre-filled.
Parsing is tested through the upload endpoint with sample exports made from a throwaway test target, plus malformed, disallowed-type, too-old and future-dated files.
user_stories.duration_assumptions: Jackson XML/StAX parser for ARF and XCCDF, reuses Finding schema and upload pipeline from 20/20a

Parsing is tested through the upload endpoint with sample exports made from a throwaway test target, plus malformed, disallowed-type, too-old and future-dated files.
